verdict.rationale: Follow Up Boss documents person (contact) records that can include relationship information, plus logging of events and externally sent texts against a lead, which gives a thin basis for per-contact activity history. The evidence never mentions company records, contact-to-company linking, or a unified activity timeline view. Missing for 10: company/organization records, linking contacts to companies, a documented full activity timeline per record, hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can manage contacts and companies as linked records with a full activity timeline on each

citations.quote: Include "relationships" in the `fields` query parameter to include relationship information.
Send in a lead or an event related to a lead.
Create a record of an externally sent text message.
